title: Escrow Cushion Schedule for Agency Policies Billed Through the Home Purchase Financing Escrow
content:
**Escrow cushion schedule — Home Purchase Financing loans whose borrower holds a Manufactured Home Insurance policy billed to the loan escrow**

The escrow cushion is the number of months of the escrow projection kept as the target low point of the escrow analysis.

Where the borrower's in-force Hearthstone Insurance Agency policy is billed to the loan escrow and escrow has paid three or more premiums to the borrower's own insurer in the 36 whole months before the analysis date, the escrow cushion is 1.0 month; where that policy is billed to the loan escrow but escrow has paid fewer than three such premiums in those 36 months, the escrow cushion is 1.5 months. Where the in-force policy is not billed to the loan escrow, no cushion is set by this schedule.

| In-force Manufactured Home Insurance policy billed to the loan escrow | Premiums paid from escrow to the borrower's own insurer in the 36 whole months before the analysis date | Escrow cushion |
|---|---|---|
| yes | three or more | 1.0 month |
| yes | fewer than three (two, one or none) | 1.5 months |
| no | any number | not set by this schedule |

**Where the facts are found.** The billing plan is shown on the borrower's in-force Manufactured Home Insurance policy with Hearthstone Insurance Agency. The premiums paid to the borrower's own insurer are the escrow disbursements recorded on the loan to the borrower's own insurer — not premiums paid to a lender-placed insurer.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical loans, policy billed to the loan escrow)

- Escrow paid exactly three premiums to the borrower's own insurer in the 36 whole months: cushion 1.0 month.
- Escrow paid two such premiums: cushion 1.5 months.
- A policy billed monthly by EFT, with five premiums paid from escrow in the period: this schedule sets no cushion.
